data.rationale: The proposal matches the weather → BBC → mail procedure and its parameters (city, date as day_of_week, traveler as recipient), but it ends with "Send" instead of "Discard", which is a risky error. It also leaves out the Mail tab and the To address format {traveler}@example.com, and it uses a day-of-week parameter and a recipient_email/name split in place of date and traveler.
